BiblicalUsage: tsâmêʼ describes thirsty (literally or figuratively). It appears 9 times in Scripture, including Psalms 107:5 and Isaiah 55:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâmêʼ belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
